_help.colors.primary: Main brand colour — heading band, cover title, links
_help.colors.secondary: Subtitle, table header row, h3 headings
_help.colors.light: Banded table rows, inline-code background, blockquote background
_help.fonts: CSS font stacks; the first family is also used for DOCX
_help.logo: Logo for HTML/PDF — SVG/PNG/JPG, relative to this file (e.g. 'assets/logo.svg' or '.\\assets\\logo.svg'). SVG stays crisp at any size.
_help.logo_raster: Optional PNG/JPG logo for DOCX (Word cannot embed SVG). If omitted, DOCX uses 'logo' when it is a PNG/JPG, else the organization name as a text wordmark.
_help.assets: Relative paths resolve against THIS theme file's folder — keep theme.json and an assets/ folder together and reference 'assets/...'.
_help.generate: Run extract_theme.py against a .pptx/.potx to fill this in from a real brand template.
